outcome: Knowledge about blood loss at delivery
Knowledge about PPH-related morbidities (transfusion and anemia)
Receipt of information about transfusion therapy
Receipt of postpartum hemoglobin (Hb) test results
cohort: 100 healthy postpartum patients who underwent vaginal or cesarean delivery
finding: Women are poorly informed about the magnitude of blood loss at delivery, and the hematologic information given to patients varies according to mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean delivery were more likely to receive clear information about transfusion therapy than those undergoing vaginal delivery, while women who underwent vaginal delivery were more likely to receive results of postpartum Hb tests compared to those undergoing cesarean delivery.
